# terms.call_resolver.LazyValue { #formulae.terms.call_resolver.LazyValue }

```python
terms.call_resolver.LazyValue(value, lexeme)
```

Deferred Python value.

This object holds a value (a string or a number).
It returns its value only when it is evaluated via `.eval()`.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**value**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`) or [numeric](`numeric`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The value it holds.

<code>[**lexeme**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The string that generated the value it holds

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [eval](#formulae.terms.call_resolver.LazyValue.eval) | Evaluates the value. |

### eval { #formulae.terms.call_resolver.LazyValue.eval }

```python
terms.call_resolver.LazyValue.eval(*args, **kwargs)
```

Evaluates the value.

Simply returns the value. Other arguments are ignored but required for consistency
among all the lazy objects.

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[**value**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} []{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The value this obejct represents.
